# Infogram

> > Infogram is a no-code data visualization platform that enables users to create interactive infographics, charts, dashboards, and reports powered by AI.

Infogram provides an intuitive suite of tools for transforming raw data into compelling visual stories. The platform serves data journalists, business analysts, marketers, and teams who need to communicate insights through interactive, customizable visualizations without requiring coding expertise.

## Key Topics

- Data visualization
- Interactive charts
- Infographics
- Dashboards
- No-code tool
- AI-powered creation
- Chart types
- Business analytics
- Data journalism
- Interactive visualization
- Brand customization
- Team collaboration
- Real-time insights
- Data comparison
- Project management

## Core Visualization Tools

- [Create Infographics That Tell Powerful Stories](https://infogram.com/create/infographic): Build interactive infographics with AI to simplify complex data
- [Create Interactive Charts](https://infogram.com/create/chart): Create interactive charts including bar, line, pie, scatter plots
- [Create Interactive Dashboards to Stand Out](https://infogram.com/create/dashboards): Transform data into dynamic dashboards for real-time insights
- [Create Interactive Reports That Drive Insights](https://infogram.com/create/report): Create dynamic data-driven reports for business analytics insights
- [Create Interactive Maps That Tell a Story](https://infogram.com/create/maps): Visualize geographic data with interactive, customizable maps

## Presentation & Design Tools

- [Create Interactive Slides to Impress Your Audience](https://infogram.com/create/slides): Create interactive presentation slides with animations and engagement
- [Create beautiful posters and impress your audience](https://infogram.com/create/posters): Design stunning posters with templates for marketing and events
- [Create Interactive Tables Now](https://infogram.com/create/table): Create engaging interactive tables with sorting and filtering

## Chart Types & Specialized Visualizations

- [Create Interactive Bar Charts to Make a Impression](https://infogram.com/create/bar-chart): Create customizable bar charts for effective data comparison
- [Explore Data Trends with Interactive Line Charts](https://infogram.com/create/line-charts): Create dynamic line charts to analyze trends and data patterns
- [Create Interactive Pie Charts to Engage and Educate](https://infogram.com/create/pie-chart): Create pie charts to visualize proportions and relationships
- [Create Interactive Column Charts to Educate](https://infogram.com/create/column-chart): Create column charts for data comparison using vertical bars
- [Create Interactive Gantt Charts to Win Over](https://infogram.com/create/gantt-charts): Create Gantt charts for project management and timeline tracking
- [Create Interactive Bubble Charts](https://infogram.com/create/bubble-chart): Create bubble charts to analyze relationships between variables
- [Create a Funnel Chart](https://infogram.com/create/funnel-chart): Create funnel charts to visualize conversion rates and pipelines
- [Create a Dual-Axis Chart](https://infogram.com/create/dual-axis-chart): Create dual-axis charts to compare multiple data sets
- [Create Interactive Treemaps](https://infogram.com/create/treemap-chart): Create treemaps to visualize hierarchical data structures
- [Create Interactive Radial Charts](https://infogram.com/create/radial-chart): Create radial charts to compare multiple variables and patterns
- [Create interactive word cloud in minutes with our easy-to-use word cloud maker.](https://infogram.com/create/word-cloud): Create word clouds to visualize and analyze text data
